exercises.title: Muted 16th Warmup
exercises.purpose: Right-hand timing, muting, relaxed subdivision control
practice_notes: Mute strings with fretting hand
Keep wrist relaxed
Accent beat 2 and 4 for the first pass
Move accents to off-beat sixteenths for variation

exercises.title: Wah Accent Groove
exercises.purpose: Coordinate wah motion with rhythmic accents
practice_notes: Use muted strums first
Open the wah only on accented notes
Keep the foot motion smaller than feels dramatic
Record one pass and listen for timing drift

exercises.title: U2-Style Delay Pulse
exercises.purpose: Practice dotted-eighth style rhythmic placement without relying on effects
practice_notes: Use clean tone first
Add delay only after the picking pattern is stable
Let notes ring without rushing the next attack
Try palm muting for dynamic control

exercises.title: Minor Pentatonic Call and Response
exercises.purpose: Build phrasing discipline and leave space
practice_notes: Play only during the call bars at first
Answer with shorter phrases than the cue
Repeat one motif before varying it
Do not fill every gap

exercises.title: Bend Intonation Drone
exercises.purpose: Practice bending to stable target pitches against a drone
practice_notes: Sing or hear the target before bending
Bend slowly into pitch, then release cleanly
Use tuner only after listening first
Stop if the fretting hand gets tense
